items.what: 清晨，小狐狸站在空旷雪原边，看着远处一盏灯
items.subject: At dawn a small fox stands at the edge of a vast snowy field, looking toward one tiny warm light from a lone lamppost far away. The cabin is not yet visible; the fox discovers it only on page two.

items.text: 清晨，雪原尽头亮着一盏灯。

items.why: 绘本第一页交代主角与远方

items.what: 小狐狸走到灯下，发现是一间小屋，窗里有人向它招手
items.subject: The small fox arrives beneath the lamp and finds a tiny cabin, where someone in the lit window waves at it

items.text: 灯下是一间小屋，窗里有人向小狐狸招手。

items.why: 绘本第二页，远方的灯变成温暖的回应
